# More Cultural Names
# Generated by the More Cultural Names Builder

on_state_owner_change = {
    on_actions = { more_cultural_names_on_state_owner_change }
}

on_state_created = {
    on_actions = { more_cultural_names_on_state_created }
}

on_become_subject = {
    on_actions = { more_cultural_names_on_become_subject }
}

on_become_independent = {
    on_actions = { more_cultural_names_on_become_independent }
}

more_cultural_names_on_state_owner_change = {
    effect = {
        more_cultural_names_evaluate_and_assign_state_hub_dynamic_names = yes
    }
}

more_cultural_names_on_state_created = {
    effect = {
        more_cultural_names_evaluate_and_assign_state_hub_dynamic_names = yes
    }
}

more_cultural_names_on_become_subject = {
    effect = {
        every_scope_state = {
            more_cultural_names_evaluate_and_assign_state_hub_dynamic_names = yes
        }
    }
}

more_cultural_names_on_become_independent = {
    effect = {
        every_scope_state = {
            more_cultural_names_evaluate_and_assign_state_hub_dynamic_names = yes
        }
    }
}
